title: FlexTEE: Dynamically Enhancing Metadata Locality Through Affine Address Transformation for Heterogeneous & Secure AI Platforms
problem: DNN accelerators in heterogeneous secure AI platforms suffer from poor metadata locality when managing Merkle tree integrity structures, causing performance bottlenecks and security vulnerabilities.
motivation: Secure AI accelerators require efficient metadata management without sacrificing security guarantees; improving metadata locality reduces memory bandwidth and latency while maintaining cryptographic integrity.
method: Apply affine address transformations to dynamically optimize Merkle tree metadata layout in accelerator memory hierarchies. Adaptively reorganize tree structures to improve cache/scratchpad locality based on runtime access patterns in heterogeneous CPU-GPU systems.
key_novelty: Dynamic metadata locality optimization via affine address transformation for Merkle tree integrity in secure heterogeneous AI accelerators.
contributions: Affine address transformation methodology for metadata locality enhancement
Adaptive Merkle tree layout optimization for heterogeneous AI platforms
Integration with secure enclave memory management
Demonstrated performance improvements in CPU-GPU heterogeneous systems
limitations: Analysis limited to abstract; specific platform implementations and overhead analysis not detailed.
primary_theme: metadata locality optimization for secure AI acceleration
